package_info.why_malicious: The package is vulnerable due to unsafe use of the Jinja2 template engine, allowing attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code via Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) when processing untrusted template data. This exposes users to remote code execution risks.

execution_context.file_location: llama_cpp_python codebase (template rendering logic using Jinja2)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code renders user-supplied template data using Jinja2 without sandboxing, allowing arbitrary code execution if the template is malicious.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Rendering untrusted templates with Jinja2 without sandboxing or input validation enables attackers to inject malicious payloads that execute arbitrary code.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal behavior would restrict template rendering to safe, static content or use Jinja2's sandboxed environment. Here, untrusted input is rendered directly, violating security best practices.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate use would involve rendering trusted templates or using Jinja2's sandboxed environment for untrusted input.
key_indicators: Absence of sandboxing or input validation
Use of Jinja2 in a context where input is not trusted

attack_chain.action: Attacker supplies a malicious template payload to the application using llama_cpp_python.
attack_chain.leads_to: Template is processed by Jinja2 without sandboxing.

attack_chain.action: Jinja2 processes the malicious template, executing arbitrary code on the host system.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains code execution, potentially leading to data theft, system compromise, or further lateral movement.

behavioral_signatures: Jinja2 template rendering with untrusted input
Execution of unexpected system commands during template rendering
Unusual child process creation from Python processes handling templates
file_indicators: Presence of user-supplied templates in model metadata or configuration files
References to jinja2.Template or similar calls in code handling external input
network_indicators: Outbound connections initiated during template rendering
Unexpected network activity from AI model serving processes
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for use of Jinja2 template rendering functions where input is not statically defined or is sourced from user/model metadata. Flag any instance where templates are rendered without sandboxing or input validation. Audit for unexpected process execution or network activity originating from processes handling AI model metadata or templates.
